answer: Unrepeatable challenge ledger. Each agent identity must answer a fresh, signed challenge derived from its own past outputs; answers are checked against a sealed reference in a vault, so replaying another agent's response fails. The check bridges identities only through one-time proofs tied to prior work. To run N sybils, an attacker must generate N distinct solvable sonnets of real prior output, paying full compute and verification cost per identity with no reuse.
